name: trip-glance
title: Trip Glance
description: A plane flies along a line that curves down to its destination, a white trail behind and green ahead.

perf.budget: The plane and trail run on one UI-thread spring when progress changes. One small view ripples at the destination until arrival.

a11y.reducedMotion: The plane jumps to its place, the time does not count and the destination does not ripple.
a11y.screenReader: One progress bar ("KN81 to OSL. 2 hours 56 minutes left. Landing early. 2 bags").

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { TripGlance } from '@/components/kinetik/trip-glance';

<TripGlance
  code="KN81"
  destination="OSL"
  minutesLeft={176}
  progress={0.34}
  status="Landing early"
  bags={2}
/>;
```

## When to use

- A trip in progress on a home screen or a live widget.
- Anywhere the time left matters more than the map.

## When not to use

- Trips with stops: one line cannot show them.
- When progress is unknown: an estimate that jumps backwards confuses people.

## Notes

- `progress` and `minutesLeft` are yours to compute.
- The plane is the Tabler Icons plane (MIT licence, via iconstack.io).

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add trip-glance`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
